scope: Phase 1 full end-to-end verification with real user-supplied gameplay backgrounds.

findings: Both videos are vertical and have visually distinct procedural backgrounds.
810px Reddit post cards change to comment cards above the subtitle safe region.

Production-length gameplay render, real-clip rotation across jobs, and target WPM on long narration remain unverified.
